anywhere.share.text: Install joblist: in your browser's menu, choose Install app or Add to Home screen. Then on an organization website, a job board or a job ad, tap Share and choose joblist.

anywhere.bookmarklet.text: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar. On an organization website, a job board or a job page, click it: joblist opens on it, to save it.

embed.intro: Paste one of these in your website: the list stays up to date by itself.

apps.firefox.title: Firefox add-on
apps.firefox.text: On any website, the joblist button shows its job board and open jobs, and saves it in your browser.

apps.firefox.step4: Pin the joblist button from the puzzle-piece menu, then click it on any website.
